109: export function bindStaticOwner<
110:   TPacket extends OwnerContractSourceDeclaration,
111:   TResources,
112:   TResourceReceipt,
113: >(
114:   packet: TPacket,
115:   owner: ExactDefinitionCallable<TPacket, TResources, TResourceReceipt>,
116:   resourceAssertionSchema: v.GenericSchema<TResources, TResources>,
117:   resourceReceiptSchema: v.GenericSchema<TResourceReceipt, TResourceReceipt>,
118: ): ExactDefinitionCallable<TPacket, TResources, TResourceReceipt> {
119:   const callable: ExactDefinitionCallable<
120:     TPacket,
121:     TResources,
122:     TResourceReceipt
123:   > = (call) => {
124:     const admittedInvocation = admitExactDefinitionCall(call, packet);
125:     if (admittedInvocation === null) {
126:       return Effect.fail(definitionFault(
127:         packet.definitionKey,
128:         "call_admission",
129:         "call_identity_mismatch",
130:         "definition call differs from its fixed module-static coordinate",
131:       ));
132:     }
133: 
134:     const admittedResources = v.safeParse(
135:       resourceAssertionSchema,
136:       call.resources,
137:     );
138:     if (!admittedResources.success) {
139:       return Effect.fail(definitionFault(
140:         packet.definitionKey,
141:         "resource_admission",
142:         "invalid_resource_assertion",
143:         "definition resources differ from the owner-authored structural contract",
144:       ));
145:     }
